plot: The Sunday after movie night, all Wheelburg talks about the old film clip of little Bolt splashing into the duck pond, which snapped before the end; embarrassed Bolt hides in his garage and even borrows the reel to make it 'get lost', while Grumpy strangely wants it locked away too; Turbo reminds Bolt that secrets get heavy, the friends watch the end privately and it shows little Grumpy coming to tow Bolt out and rolling in backwards too; Bolt laughs at last, the whole town watches at sunset; lesson: laugh with your friends and silly moments become happy memories; then Pip learns her helper for the school film contest is Grumpy.

script.title: Bolt Fell in the Duck Pond?!

set.place: Wheelburg town square and Bolt's garage corner, the Sunday morning after movie night, until sunset

script.description: Bolt's old pond splash is on film — and so is someone else. Inspector Bolt #21

beats.say: Splash! Splash! Bolt went splash in the duck pond!
Turbo! Please! Not so loud. The whole town is listening.
The film stopped right at the splash! What happened next?
Nothing happened. Nothing at all. Good morning, everyone.
And Inspector Bolt drove into his garage corner and stayed there.
It was Sunday morning, the day after movie night in Wheelburg.
Last night the old film had snapped. Right at the biggest splash.
Good morning, everyone! I fixed the film! It works again!
Oh, wonderful! I want to see the end! The whole end!
Hmph. Some old films should stay in the box.
Nobody needs to see the end. Trust me.
Why not, Grumpy? Do you know what happens?
I know nothing. I am a tow truck. I tow.
Grumpy looked away very quickly. Pip tilted her head.
I filmed it myself, you know. When I was tiny!
My very first camera. Wobbly pictures. Lots of laughing.
Hal, let's show it tonight! Here in the square! For everyone!
In his corner, Bolt heard every single word.
The whole town? Laughing at little me? Oh dear, oh dear.
Bolt, it was so funny! You went whoosh, then sploosh!
Funny for you, Turbo. Not so funny for me.
Turbo stopped laughing. He knew that heavy feeling. From yesterday.
Sorry, Bolt. I didn't know it made you sad.
Bolt, what is the worst part? The splash?
The worst part is a detective who falls into a pond.
Detectives must look clever. Always. That is the rule.
The show starts at sunset! Bertha is bringing the chairs!
Sunset? That is only a few hours away!
Then Bolt had an idea. A detective idea. A sneaky idea.
Hal, may I hold the film? Just to check it. Carefully.
Of course, old friend! Here you go.
And now the old film was with Bolt.
Bolt? Why are you driving away with it?
Me? I am checking it. Very far away. In my garage.
Bolt parked in his garage and stared at the film.
If this film got lost, nobody would laugh. Easy.
But that isn't right, is it? Hmm.
Bolt! Remember what you told me yesterday? About secrets?
You said a secret gets heavier and heavier. You did!
I did say that. Oh, bother. You were listening.
Bolt. Give me that film. I'll lock it in my tow yard.
Grumpy! You want it hidden too? But why?
No reason. Just tidy. I like tidy things.
Grumpy's tow hook was shaking. Grumpy's hook never shakes.
Two friends who want one film hidden? Very strange!
I know! We watch the end first. Just us. Right now!
Friends first, town later! Hal, the projector, please!
Ready! Pointing it at the garage wall!
The film began to roll. Click, click, click.
There was little Bolt, learning to drive beside the duck pond.
Look at your hat! It is bigger than you!
Little Hally honked. Little Bolt jumped. And... splash!
Here it comes. The end of my detective life.
But the film kept rolling. Someone came to pull little Bolt out.
A small grey tow truck. With a very shaky hook.
Little Grumpy pulled. He slipped. And he rolled in too. Backwards!
Two splashes! A double splash! Best film ever!
That's why I wanted it locked away. Hmph.
I was going to be the hero. I became a fountain.
Bolt looked at Grumpy. Grumpy looked at Bolt.
A fountain! Oh, Grumpy. You were a lovely fountain!
And Bolt laughed. A big, warm, honking laugh.
Heh. Heh-heh. It was a very good splash.
In the film, little Bolt and little Grumpy laughed too. Dripping wet.
See? It isn't a sad film. It's a friendship film!
Hal. Show it tonight. The whole thing. To everyone.
Even the double splash?
Especially the double splash!
At sunset, the whole town sat in the square to watch.
When the splash came, everybody laughed. Bolt laughed the loudest.
Laugh with your friends, and silly moments become happy memories.
Silly moments become happy memories! I love that one!
One splash only. Nobody mention the second one.
Too late, Grumpy. Everybody saw the second one.
Pip, didn't your class get a letter today?
Oh! A film contest! Every kid gets a grown-up helper!
And my helper is... wait. Him?!
What do you think Bolt will find next time? We'll find out in the next episode!
